claims.text: Súľov is a northern Slovakia climbing area in the Súľovské vrchy landscape.

The source reports 1,541 routes across 17 crags, with grades from easy 4s up to 9a+.
The source gives late spring to early autumn, May to October, as the best season.
The source says Súľov is best reached by car and that public transport is limited but possible via train and bus connections to nearby towns.
